scientific_integrity.evidence_basis: Constructive component classification, exact EGF and recurrence, independent finite enumeration, direct modal-powerset checks, and comparisons with named prior sources.
scientific_integrity.not_claimed: No independent formal certification; no statement of global exhaustive literature coverage; no authorship claim.

scientific_limitations: Counts labelled ordered pairs of finite equivalences, not simultaneous relabelling isomorphism types.
The total number of commuting equivalence-relation pairs is known from OEIS A354458; only the joint refinements, modal output ranks and sharp support are claimed here.
Direct checks are finite; the general result is supported by a mathematical proof. An equivalent prior multivariate refinement may exist.
title: Joint modal-saturation rank census for commuting finite equivalence relations
